purpose: Close the public browser commissioning failure at installed-runtime verification.

initialFailure.message: The installed XRP runtime does not match this course release.
initialFailure.fileReadback: All installed file SHA-256 values matched the release before the runtime import check.
initialFailure.cause: MicroPython returned pre-repair ucsb_xrp and ucsb_xrp_service modules retained in sys.modules by the running pre-repair service. The verifier compared those in-memory version constants after replacing their files.

correction.behavior: Before import verification, remove only ucsb_xrp, ucsb_xrp_reference, and ucsb_xrp_service package entries from sys.modules, collect unused objects, and import the newly written files.
correction.diagnostics: A remaining mismatch reports each installed and expected library or service version and any missing XRPLib module.

motion.reason: Commissioning, service discovery, telemetry, and project transfer close this defect without a motor run.
